address: Av. Constituyentes, Playa del Carmen, 77720, Mexico
bio: As one of the most popular taquerias in Playa del Carmen, you will find a busy dining room at almost all hours of the day. No matter, the grill works fast, creating plumes of smoke to sear meats just shaved off the spinning trompo. The menu is endless but most just stick to the simple pleasures of an honest taco spiked with tableside salsas....
